Welcome to the Inclusion page at The Horsell Village School
At The Horsell Village School, we value each child's unique learning styles, strengths, and needs. We believe that children with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) should have full curriculum access, developing as successful learners through high-quality teaching and sensitive communication.
Emotional Literacy Support Assistant (ELSA)
Our ELSA provision supports the emotional well-being of our students, helping them develop skills to manage emotions and build positive relationships. They work with students one-to-one or in small groups. Sessions are engaging and interactive, using games, role-play, and creative activities to support emotional growth.

Clubs
At The Horsell Village School we believe that learning extends beyond the classroom. Our diverse range of externally run extra-curricular clubs offer children the opportunity to explore new interests, develop essential life skills, and build friendships. Whether your child is interested in sports, arts, music, or languages, there is something for everyone to enjoy.
Clubs timetable - Autumn Term 2026
Check the timetable above to see when each club is held. Select the day to find more details about each club.
Before School
Olympics Club
Monday 8.00am-8.40am open to all years
Come along before school to learn and participate in a variety of Olympic sports, including athletics, long jump, triple jump, discus, and foam javelin.
After School
Street Dance - Boogie Pumps
Monday 3.20pm-4.20pm open to all years
Energetic, fun, fancy footwork, big leaps &quick turns. Our classes are full of current pop songs that will keep you humming all the way home. Summer Term Archives - Boogie Pumps Bookings
Art with Rose
Art Monday 3.20pm-4.20pm followed directly by Theatre 4.30pm-5.30pm **later finish**
Art - An opportunity for children to express themselves as creatively as they like, and take home their fun, mixed media art work every week.
Theatre - designed to inspire young performers, helping them build confidence while making new friends in a supportive environment.
Before School
Wake & Stretch
Tuesdays 8.00am-8.45am open to all years in the school hall (children will be dismissed straight to their classroom)
A vibrant and joyful way for children to start their day with enthusiasm, positivity, and a burst of energy. This before-school program is dedicated to promoting physical fitness, emotional well-being, and mental clarity in children of all ages, all while having a whole lot of fun. https://motion-dance.classforkids.io/term/105
Lunchtime
Chess Club
This is a structured but fun course for years 1 & 2. By the end of a term your child will be able to play chess. Chess has been linked with improving children’s concentration, problem-solving, critical, original and creative thinking – and even mathematical abilities. Due to the structure of the course new starters are only recommended at the start of a new term.
Spanish Club
Spanish is taught in small groups using songs, games, story-telling, role play and activity sheets. The club aims to give children a FUN introduction to the language and the culture and inspire them for future learning of the language. Suitable for years 1 & 2.
After School
Ultimate Coaching Football
Tuesdays 3.20pm-4.25pm open to All Years (Reception from the Spring term)
Our FA qualified, professional coaches deliver fun, active football sessions which include learning new skills and techniques, small-sided games and competitions with chances to win awards for performance and achievement. Please note bookings are made half termly to allow for greater flexibility. Reception children are invited to join the club from the start of the Spring term. To book follow the links Reception bookings and Yr 1 & 2 Bookings
Before School
JustPlay Music
Wednesday 8.00am-8.40am open to all years in the school hall (children will be dismissed straight to their classroom)
The Intro to Music Breakfast Club offers students an inspiring start to their day. Embracing their motto of 'Learn - Create - Perform', children will explore a variety of musical elements including ukulele, percussion, rhythm, and keyboard skills. Led by experienced tutors from JustPlay Music School, this program provides a dynamic environment where students can develop their musical abilities, foster creativity, and build confidence through performance opportunities. To sign up please use the following link https://justplaymusicschool.co.uk/signup/
Lunchtime
French Club Yr 1
A fun introduction to the French language with a variety of interactive oral activities, games, songs, rhymes, stories and puppets.
After School
Lego Coding Club
Wednesday 3.20pm-4.20pm
Build, code, and create! Our After School LEGO Coding Club gives children the chance to explore coding, engineering, and problem-solving through fun, hands-on LEGO projects. Using simple coding concepts, participants will bring their LEOG creations to life while developing creativity, teamwork, and confidence in a supportive and engaging environment. No previous coding experience is needed - just curiosity and a love of building!
Art with Rose
Wednesday 3.20pm-4.20pm
An opportunity for children to express themselves as creatively as they like, and take home their fun, mixed media art work every week.
Sporty Kidz - Multi-Sports
Wednesdays 3.20pm-4.20pm open to all years
Multi-Sports Club - Throughout the year children will try Football, TAG Rugby, Hockey, Tennis, Athletics, Dodgeball, Basketball, Benchball, Cricket and Rounders! Sporty Kidz invite you to come join in the fun with their energetic games, where your child will learn a variety of sports skills with a big smile on their face, led by their team of sports coaches.
Before School
Cricket
Thursday 8.00am-8.40am open to all years
Bat, bowl, and field in our before-school sessions! Learn and refine all the core cricket techniques before progressing into smaller-sided, match-style games.
Just Play Music
Thursday 8:00am - 8:40am open to all years in the Canteen
The Intro to Music Breakfast Club offers students an inspiring start to their day. Embracing the motto of 'Learn - Create - Perform' children will explore a variety of musical elements including Ukulele, percussion, rhythm and keyboard skills. Led by experienced tutors from JustPlay Music school provides a dynamic environment where students can develop their musical abilities, foster creativity and build confidence through performance opportunities. To sign up please use the following link https://justplaymusicschool.co.uk/signup/
Lunchtime
French Club Yr 2
A fun introduction to the French language with a variety of interactive oral activities, games, songs, rhymes, stories and puppets.
Woking Gym Club
Offering gymnastics classes for all abilities in a fun and friendly environment. Woking Gym Club school gymnastics classes cater to all abilities, whether your child is a beginner or has prior experience. Each session follows their club's tailored programme, focusing on different floor and vault elements weekly.
After school
Basketball
Thursday 3.20pm-4.20pm for Yrs 1 & 2
Pass, dribble, and (maybe!) dunk in this exciting after-school club. In2Sports qualified coaches will deliver expert instruction, perfect for developing skills on the court.
Cooking with Dee
Thursday 3.20pm-4.20pm open to all years
Join Dee to learn basic culinary skills whilst cooking healthy recipes in a fun manner. Email damanbamra@hotmail.com to book or find out more information.
Before School
Archery
Friday 8.00am-8.40am open to all years
Archery wake-up clubs are a fun, engaging activity for everyone! The children start by mastering the fundamentals, stance, safety, and aiming, then move on to games like Archery Bingo and Archery Angry Birds.
After School
Sporty Kidz - Tennis or Fun Fitness & Multi-Skills
Friday 3.20pm-4.20pm open to all years
Tennis - Children will learn the fundamental skills of mini tennis with their lighter balls and smaller courts ideal for beginner players.
Fun Fitness & Multi-Skills - Led by Sporty Kidz coaches, the children will learn a variety of movement and sports skills, through their FUN, energetic games, with a big smile on their face!
Suitable for boys and girls of all ages.
Click here to see a full timetable with locations and pickup points
If you wish to enquire about any of our clubs please contact the club leaders directly. Details of the clubs can be found by clicking on the club name which is located under the day the club is held.
Please bear in mind when considering booking a club that club leaders are not normally able to facilitate taking the children at the end of the activity across the road to Horsell Village After School Club. You would need to have this agreed and arranged in advance with the club leader.
Please note Reception children are not offered the option to join the clubs for the first half of the Autumn Term while they are settling in. After which it is at the discretion of the club.
Participating in extra-curricular activities helps children build confidence and self-esteem. They learn to set goals, overcome challenges, and celebrate their achievements.
Clubs provide a platform for children to interact with their peers, fostering teamwork, communication, and empathy.
Engaging in activities outside the classroom can boost performance and give children a more positive attitude towards school.
Many of our clubs involve physical activity, promoting a healthy lifestyle and helping children develop motor skills and coordination.
Extra-curricular activities offer a creative outlet for children to express themselves.

Welcome From The Headteacher
Welcome to The Horsell Village School’s website.
It’s a great pleasure to welcome you to our school through our website.
We are a three-form entry Infant School located in the heart of Horsell Village. There are 270 children in school aged between 4 and 7 years. Our team of dedicated and enthusiastic staff and governors are committed to ensuring the very best for every child and providing them with the opportunities to succeed in an ever-changing world.
Our school motto ‘Kindness to yourself, Kindness to others and Kindness to the World’ underpins everything we do here at The Horsell Village School. Supporting children to develop an understanding of how to learn and to express and manage the emotions within this is fundamental is supporting them to develop into lifelong learners as well as rounded citizens who will go on to make a positive contribution to society.
Our curriculum reflects the needs of our learners and is built on key principles which include enquiry-based learning, outside learning, mental Health and well-being and values-based approach. We focus on the key knowledge, skills, understanding and the vocabulary the children need in each subject, building on the previous years learning as they move through the school.
Community and the relationships formed is the golden thread that brings us all together. Here at The Horsell Village School we believe in working together to ensure our children get the best possible start to their educational journey.
We hope you enjoy our website and it gives you an insight into our wonderful school.
We warmly welcome visits, so please do get in touch.
Jane Reeve
